WHO WE ARE
Rock Manufacturing is a small-caliber ammunition manufacturer based in Sweet Springs, Missouri, producing projectiles, load ammunition, and components, along with in-house loading and priming. Founded in its current form in 2023, we are a well-capitalized company in a high-growth chapter, vertically integrating our production and building toward a significant revenue milestone over the coming year.

...

The Rock Manufacturing team is looking for a results-driven and execution-focused VP of Operations to take full ownership of how the business runs day to day. This is a hands-on integrator role for an operator who turns vision into reality, drives accountability across the floor, and keeps major initiatives moving from idea to completed deliverable.
The VP of Operations is responsible for optimizing the company's day-to-day execution, designing and implementing the infrastructure and processes that boost productivity and efficiency, and freeing the executive team to focus on their highest-value work. The application code word is EMPOWER. The VP of Operations is a driver. They take a high-level goal, figure out the details independently, and hold the team accountable to getting it done.

...

This is a boots-on-the-ground, on-site role based at our plant in Sweet Springs, Missouri. Building trust with the production floor is central to your success, so your presence on-site is essential. This is a critical position within the business, and as such, we host a rigorous, 4-part application process.

...

REQUIREMENTS (EXPECTED PROFICIENCIES):
Experience Requirements (Non-Negotiable)
* Proven track record scaling a business through the $3M to $20M growth phase, ideally in a manufacturing, production, or operations-heavy environment
* Exceptional project management ability, with a history of driving processes, pushing initiatives forward, and holding teams accountable to deliverables
* A genuine boots-on-the-ground operator who leads from the floor and is energized by being on-site and close to the work
* Direct experience in ammunition manufacturing is helpful but not required. What matters is operational excellence and the ability to learn a production environment quickly

...

Technical & Logistical Requirements
* Able to work on-site full time in Sweet Springs, Missouri (relocation support available for the right candidate.
* Exceptional attention to detail, time-management, and organizational skills
* Data-driven decision maker who can analyze information and act on it
* Highly resourceful self-starter who thrives without direct supervision
* Experienced with ERP implementation in a manufacturing environment

...

* First 30 days: Immerse on the production floor, build trust with the team, learn the systems, and map the operational back end leadership currently carries.
* By 60 days: Take ownership of the administrative, sourcing, and quality back end, and establish a weekly accountability rhythm that ensures follow-through on leadership initiatives.
* By 90 days: Production tracking and KPIs are live, scrap and quality improvements are underway, and the new production operation launch is on track.
